description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a split document view: the opened document stays in the center while the current conversation remains visible on the right. It provides a per-session toggle, a resizable divider with keyboard support, an optional auto-enter setting, three layout presets, and a Document/Chat switch for narrow windows. Only the window layout changes; editing, saving and preview continue to use the host's native document and Office viewers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加分栏文档视图的 bundle：打开的文档居中显示，当前会话保留在右侧。支持按会话保存的开关、可拖动并支持键盘调节的分隔线、可选的自动进入设置、三种布局预设，以及窄窗口下的「文档 / 对话」切换。仅调整窗口布局，编辑、保存与预览继续沿用宿主原生文档与 Office 查看器。
